about.story:
It all began with me. With wanting to become better.

I was looking for something that would help me overcome my weaknesses, keep going, and take at least one small step forward every day.

That is how NAFS was born.

“Nafs” (نَفْس) is an Arabic word meaning “soul,” “self,” or the inner “I.”

Each of us has our own struggle — with desires, weaknesses, and habits. And sometimes the hardest victory is the victory over ourselves.

At first, I was creating NAFS for myself. But then I realized: perhaps, somewhere, there is someone facing the same struggle.

If one day NAFS helps you keep going, make the right choice, and become even a little better — then all of this will have been worthwhile.

Created with sincere intention. From heart to heart.
